end_user_total_cost.description: Cumulative cost of the session to the driver, as of last_updated. incl_vat is REQUIRED; it equals excl_vat when no VAT applies.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. MUST be the currency of the tariffs returned for the session.

last_updated.description: Moment at which the eMSP computed this cost, on its own clock.

tariff.description: Tariff the eMSP applies to this session as of last_updated. When present, it replaces the §3 tariff for display.

else.description: Cost fields and tariff are present only with AVAILABLE.
